extraction_notes: The audit period covers 01 April 2019 to 30 October 2019. The report explicitly states on page 29, section 1.6.1, that GSDP figures for this partial period were not available, hence all fiscal indicators expressed as a percentage of GSDP are reported as 0. The GSDP absolute figure is also reported as 0 as the available figure (page 102) is for the full fiscal year, not the partial audit period. The money value of observations is taken from outstanding Utilisation Certificates (page 18, Para 4.7).
